header.about: Quicksilver's backstab rules. kind bs: the engine's stab damage range [min, max] before any critical, from a player with Strength 50 and the given weapon; class_stealth false means race stealth only (the 75% cut). kind crit: the range [lowest, highest] a critical stab rolls, given the stab's [bs_min, bs_max] (no damage reduction); a stock stab never crits so neutral is null. v120 is the 1.20.0 balance, neutral has stock-equivalent stealth divisor, level percentage and no level cap, alt is an off-grid balance (see balance_keys).
